items.title: Nike Keeps Tanking: One Pro Expects 85% Returns Moving Forward
items.summary: Nike has shed nearly half its value in a year while executives quietly sold millions in shares, yet one analyst team is holding a price target that would make the stock the biggest winner in its peer group. The gap between that call and reality raises a question worth answering.

items.title: 3 Profitable Stocks That Fall Short
items.summary: Not all profitable companies are built to last - some rely on outdated models or unsustainable advantages. Just because a business is in the green today doesn’t mean it will thrive tomorrow.

items.title: Nike Falls 3% to a Fresh 52-Week Low as China Weakness Overshadows Its Wholesale Rebound
items.summary: Nike just hit a fresh 52-week low even as its wholesale numbers are actually improving, and the contradiction at the heart of that gap reveals why Wall Street analysts are split further apart on this stock than almost any other name in retail.
